instruction: You are choosing sunscreen for a child who dislikes stinging or sticky sunscreen. Open the shopping website, compare kids sunscreen products using customer reviews, choose the best-fitting product, and add it to the cart.
gt_steps: Compare customer reviews for kids sunscreen products.
Choose the mineral sunscreen product whose reviews best match the no-sting, easy daily-use preference.
Select the cheapest option combination for the chosen product if options are required.
Add `Banana Boat Kids Vanishing Color, Amazing Apple and Berry Blast Reef Frienfly Broad Spectrum Mineral Sunscreen Foam Twin Pack (Apple & Berry), SPF 50, 4oz. Each` to the shopping cart.
